query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_address) as unique_addresses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(created_at)) as days_with_orders,
  MIN(created_at) as earliest_order,
  MAX(created_at) as latest_order,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as orders_with_coords
FROM orders;
